add_ons.description: Add an extra Walkie-Talkie for convenient poolside communication. Perfect for coaches, families, and teams.

risks: Bringing a new hardware product from prototype to mass production always comes with challenges. While we have completed multiple rounds of engineering prototypes, functional testing, and waterproof validation, there are still areas that require careful management during production. The main challenges include finalizing manufacturing processes, maintaining consistent product quality, completing certification requirements, and managing the production timeline. To reduce these risks, we have already established cooperation with experienced manufacturing partners, completed prototype verification, and performed multiple rounds of testing before entering mass production. We will continue to closely monitor production progress, conduct quality inspections, and keep our backers updated throughout the manufacturing and shipping process. Our goal is to deliver a reliable underwater audio experience while ensuring every unit meets our quality standards.
